title: Carving Radiology Reports at Their Evidential Joints: Anatomical Region Sets as Generation Units
abstract: arXiv:2610.29165v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Organizing radiology reports into independently generated units offers a way to generate fine-grained clinical content and bind it to visual evidence. However, existing methods typically adopt generation-unit structures not directly specified in natural reports or their annotations, introducing additional modeling compromises. We propose RadCarve, which instead defines generation units directly from the anatomical region sets in existing statement-region correspondences, unifying unit formation with visual evidence selection. RadCarve's planner uses composition-specialized query banks to jointly predict unit existence and region composition from the image, iteratively refining both with regional evidence aggregated according to current membership predictions. The generator independently produces each unit's text conditioned on the joint visual evidence of its predicted region set. Compared with strong baselines, RadCarve improves CXRFESc

translated_title: 沿证据关节切分放射学报告：以解剖区域集合作为生成单元
translated_abstract: 将放射学报告组织成可独立生成的单元，为生成细粒度的临床内容并将其与视觉证据相绑定提供了一种途径。然而，现有方法通常采用的生成单元结构并非直接来源于自然报告或其标注中的规定，这引入了额外的建模妥协。我们提出RadCarve，它直接从现有语句-区域对应关系中的解剖区域集合来定义生成单元，将单元的形成与视觉证据选择统一起来。RadCarve的规划器使用面向区域组合的专用查询库，从图像中联合预测单元的存在性与区域组成，并根据当前成员预测所聚合的区域证据对两者进行迭代优化。生成器以其预测区域集合的联合视觉证据为条件，独立生成每个单元的文本。与强大的基线相比，RadCarve在CXRFESc（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 提出RadCarve方法，直接以放射学报告中现成语句-区域对应关系里的解剖区域集合作为生成单元，将单元划分与视觉证据选择统一，从而生成与视觉证据紧密绑定的细粒度放射学报告。
en_tdlr: RadCarve defines generation units directly from anatomical region sets in existing statement-region correspondences, unifying unit formation with visual evidence selection to produce fine-grained radiology reports grounded in visual evidence.
